parent: lean_channel_attention_training_pilot_v1.json; use only its frozen train and validation sequence groups and selected frames. No priority-sequence labels or features are used during training or model choice.
purpose: Engineering-scale supervised feature-discrimination pilot. The primary output is whether a reproducible trained gate differs from matched controls on held-out sequences; it is not a full-video or independent-patient result.

conditions.prompt_conditioned: Author CBAM channel gate receives the same sequence's automatic foreground and negative-background prototypes.
conditions.descriptor_independent: The identical author gate, parameter count, optimizer and initialization receives zero descriptors; feature contrast still uses the correct automatic prototypes.
conditions.mismatched_prompt: The identical author gate receives another sequence's automatic prototypes under a fixed cycle; feature contrast still uses the correct automatic prototypes. Training cycle seq2→seq3→seq4→seq2; validation cycle seq9↔seq10. This control tests descriptor specificity, not a claim of causal background semantics.
conditions.unweighted: No trainable gate: existing automatic-prototype feature contrast.
conditions.rgb: No trainable gate: existing RGB foreground/background contrast, computed using the same automatic prompt and source frames.

training.loss: fixed class-balanced soft binary cross entropy with logits equal to 8 times the 64x64 score; on GT-empty targets use ordinary mean background BCE
training.epoch_selection: fixed final epoch; no early stopping or validation tuning
training.initialization: identical seed and author initialization; final channel-gate linear layer zeroed so all channel weights begin uniformly at 0.5
training.schedule: same deterministic frame order for each trainable arm; no labels enter inference

evaluation: Freeze every arm before validation. Report per-sequence supervised score discrimination on positive frames and score distributions on empty frames; no claim of false-alarm rate from a continuous score without segmentation. Follow with same-state memory utility controls before any video propagation. Patient identity is unknown and all data were previously inspected.
provenance: Record train and validation video identities, all feature/mask hashes, optimization protocol, source hashes, split manifest, exact feature pipeline and backbone hashes, seeds, loss history and checkpoint parameter fingerprint. Any candidate checkpoint must be retrievable without fabricating metadata.
